rows.reason: Both harnesses ship a `/goal` (read in Claude Code 2.1.285 and Codex 0.159.2), but not one form a root can arm the same way on both. On Claude Code it is a stop condition the operator types, capped at 4000 characters and refused in an untrusted workspace or with hooks restricted; the model's own route is the `ProposeGoal` tool, which the operator can switch off and which refuses to run in a subagent or outside an interactive local session. On Codex it sits behind the experimental goals feature and needs a saved session. A file is the same on both harnesses and the tick can re-read it: the program objective goes into the standing orders and is restated in the todolist (`update_plan` on Codex). The Platform Adaptation section of SKILL.md names the file that holds the standing orders.

rows.reason: The tick runs on Claude Code's `loop` skill. Dynamic mode re-arms itself through `ScheduleWakeup` (60 to 3600 s).
